propositions: Top-level commands cannot uniformly declare required package extras because optionality varies by nested mode, workflow, analyzer, renderer, or provider, and early enforcement would hide stable verbs and break lean diagnostic paths.

A stdlib-only semantic capability registry must map 14 immutable records, each naming a semantic key, packaging extra, and missing posture (error, unavailable, abstain, or fallback), validated without importing probe modules.

Shared error helper must invoke only after mode/backend selection at chosen execution boundaries (e.g., audit serve after audit show, provider selection before client construction) to preserve lean diagnostic behavior and existing domain control of result payloads.

Every capability must validate against exactly one declared packaging extra and one typed posture, stable verbs and help must remain present in no-extras wheel, and only the selected boundary must emit actionable error for error postures.
Metrics, pricing, grounding, and fallback capabilities retain existing domain output, exception, stream, and exit contracts; registry never manufactures their results.
Separate entrypoints mcp_server and review_bot must remain capabilities without CLI routes, and import hooks must block heavy modules during registry and help construction.
